book.name: Matyu
book.title: God tal ol na tongwo ha maing yal Matyu mining bongwo dimia.

content: Yisas ha di bole ari er wain honagi ol tenamua dungwo ha
“Ena God kene ongwo hol iwe, maing yu pamia. Yal ta er wain miki weni kul nenamia. Kul nerere honagi ari igere u sina i honagi onama dire honmil sinamo namia.
Pirere yalhobi di ku bolere, ari haung tani honagi onanga, wan kina wan kina ni teralua dinamia. Yalhobi owo, para dinua dire, yong tani ere honagi onamia.
Onangure wain hong yal omare, nain klok, pire hanamba, yal tau ya monangure hanamia.
Hanere yu ditenamia. Yalhobo, ni honagi ol na tenanga, tobo kunu ni teralue.
Dinangure yalhobi honagi oli namia. Nangure wain hong yal i omare twel klok ya, te, pudinangwo tri klok pi hanamba, yal tau ereyu ya monangure hanamia. Hanere homa dungwo meri yu ditenamia.
Ditere pudinangwo, paib klok, Maket pire hanamia. Hanamba, yal tau ereyu ya monangure hanere yu ditenamia, “Honmil ya mongarai, omare ya mongarai, pudungwo para, ya monio?”
Dinangure yalhobi yu ditenamia, “Na yalhobi yal ta honagi ebir si na tekungwo yawe.”

Dinamba, wain hong yali yu ditenamia. “Wain honagi ol na tenana pio,” dinamua. Ditere, ari ya benangwo haung, wain hong yal i, bosboi gala dire yu ditenamia, “Yahuno. Ni honagi ari di ku bolere, tobo to. Tenangiwe, emgi ure honagi ongwo hobi pe homa terere, te homa ure ongwo hobi pe emgi to,” dinamia.
Dinangure bosboi han molere emgi ongwo hobi wan kina wan kina tenamia.
Tenangwo hanere honmil sinamo ongwo hobi “O, na moni bir iralua” di pinamia. Di pinamba, homa ongwo emgi ongwo hobi para, tobo kunu kunu inamua.
Irere wain hong yali nigi de pir tere yu dungwi,
“Yalhobi emgi umiraya, honagi obilga omia, te na yalhobi honmil sinamoki ure honagi ol mominga, mominga, ari dere bukuniminga irai hamen girimia, tobo kunu kunu na tengiwe.”
Dinangure wain hong yal iwe, urere, yal ta yu ditenamia. “Yahuno, nan homa yona tani erere, wan kina ni tenaminua diminga, ni para bemua dingirawe. Na tal nigi dongwo omno?
Para ni tominia, ire po. Ni tominga meri iwe, honagi emgi ongwo yalhobi ere kunu yu tominua.
Tominga i, na nan hana paikimo? Na nan hana pamia. Na pirari pare tobo bir ni teya, ni nigi de pir na teno? dire wain hong yal yu dinamua,” dungwi.

Dire Yisas hon ainere yu ditongwi, “Eno. Ganba baniya singaba moliwa di pire, hamil ha sira, eang dire bol hona monangwo yaliwe, emgi hon u bisi namua. Te yal bina ta bol bisi ala monangwo yaliwe, emgi hon u bol hona i molere, eang dinamua,” dungwi.
Yisas gole hon airalua gin sui tai dire dungwo ha
Ena Yisas Yerusalem nala dire, grang wine ongwo hobi ana holo holo kebena sutani aule ire ongwi. Pi hol bangi pirere awa ha ditongwi,

“Pino. Omaga nan yalhobi Yerusalem namna dire uminia. Pi pa dinaminga, Na Ari Wang Weni iwe, yal tau na han holere, ha maing ari singaba tau, lo ana holo holo kene ongwo yal tau na tenamia. Tenangure na ha hol ol na terere, ni sigolalua di na tere, na auli pire ari wiyol ta monangwo bani olamia.
Olangure gauna ha sirere, homa kuba na sirere, er pera bani na si gonamua. Golere, ari habang sui tai dire pai molgere, emgi God hon ulna yunangure airalua” dungwi.
Yems Yon kina singaba morabila di pungwo ha
Ena Sebedi eungbi wang sutani aule ire Yisas mongwo bani ongwi. Pirere sirin bongwi.
Bomba, Yisas aang i yu ditongwi, “Na tal ol ni terale?” dungwi. “Kene ole kemilanga haung na wana suri u dalni holo holi monamba?”
Dimba Yisas yu ditongwi, “Ni ha ogolo pir kun ole dikinia. Ni yasuri na gauna gul iralga meri inano?” Dungure yasuri, “Owo, para yu irabilua” dungwi.
“Para dinia. Na gauna gul iralga meri inania. Inanba, yal ta u na dalna holo holi monangure nu ke tenaminga paikimia. Nabe God nin hanere, nu ke terere, a yo te tenangwo pamua,” dungwi.
Ena Yisas grang wine ongwo ana holo holo iwe, ha dungwo i pirere yong ki e tongwi.
Tomba Yisas gamahobo ana holo holo hon i ku bole yu ditongwi, “Baniya yal tau singaba molere, hamil ha sire gamahobi honagi ha ditongwo hanua.
Yu omiba, ni yalhobi ongwo meri olkio. Yal ta singaba molala di pinangiwe, ya ime sire nir honagi oli nanga pamua.
Yal ta eang dire bol hona molala di pinangiwe, ya ime sire gamnahobi yon bani enangure awai honagi ol te monanua.

Ari Wang Weni na molere, olga meri onanua. Na iwe, hamil ha sire, honagi ha diterala dire, ta huiwa. Awai honagi olala dire wiwa. Ganba ari para weni pring pangwo ipire na gol tegere, sigare kule u wai nama dire, wiwa,” dungwi.
Yisas omeling gi dungwo yal su apila di tongwo ha
Ena Yisas grang wine ongwo hobi kina Yeriko malgi u pa dungwi. Pa dire aidolere, ere ongure, ari miki weni u mobing engure ongwi.
Omba omeling gi dungwo yal sutani homaulung ami di molere, “Yisas u omua” dungwo pirere yasuri gala bir dire yu dungwi, “Yasingaba Debit gang ye. Na yasuri milna pir na tomo?”
Dimba arihobi yasuri kura ha ditere “Sime molo,” ditongwi. Ditomba, yasuri pir uning sire gala bir dire yu dungwi, “Yal Yisas Debit gangye. Na yasuri milna pir na tomo?”
Dungure Yisas pirere ira mole yu ditongwi, “Na tal ol ni teralga meri pine?”
Dungure yasuri Yisas yu ditongwi, “Yahuno, na yasu omena gi dungwo a pila di na tenana di pibilua.”
Dungure Yisas yasuri miling pirere omeling bani a to sungwi. Sungure yasuri gintani omeling wai dungure talhan para weni hanere Yisas doling bol ongwi.
